title: Two-dimensional quantum lattice gas algorithm for anisotropic Burger-like equations
summary: Building on hybrid quantum lattice gas algorithm, we revisit the possibilities of this quantum lattice model. By deriving a correction to the predicted viscosity, we provide analytical and numerical results that refine original formulation. We introduce a minimal 2D generalization of the algorithm, which allows to simulate anisotropic Burgers like equations while retaining only two lattice velocities.
